Class Question

java.lang.Object
ass2.ass2_jfx.model.Question
public class Question extends Object
Represents a multiple-choice question. A Question consists of: - The question text - An array of four possible answers - The index of the correct answer This class is immutable. Once created, its values cannot be changed.
Version:
Java 21
Author:
Shane O'Connell, Joshua MacPherson
